name: Nathan Finch
source:
The Protaganist.

Nathan is considered by most to be rather unremarkable, but he does have his talents. He makes good marks in most subjects and also manages to be surprisingly perceptive and understanding when it comes to others. 

When the breakout occurs, Nathan is the only escapee who remains powerless.
